title: Especialista em 3D
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em Projetos 3D para integrar o time criativo da Match!

Buscamos uma pessoa que una pensamento estratégico, visão estética e domínio técnico, capaz de transformar conceitos criativos em ambientes tridimensionais que expressem a essência das marcas com as quais trabalhamos.

Essa função conecta as áreas de Criação, Estratégia e Produção, garantindo que cada projeto — seja uma ativação de marca, estande, evento ou experiência imersiva — seja executado com excelência técnica, coerência estética e impacto visual.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Criar e desenvolver projetos 3D de ativações e espaços de marca;

Traduzir briefings em soluções visuais criativas e tecnicamente viáveis;

Garantir coerência entre conceito criativo e execução técnica;

Acompanhar fornecedores e revisar detalhamentos técnicos e medidas;

Apoiar o time de produção na escolha de materiais e montagem;

Realizar benchmarks e propor inovações visuais;

Participar ativamente da construção de apresentações e defesas de projeto;

Colaborar com áreas internas para assegurar consistência com o guia visual das marcas.

Requisitos:

Domínio de SketchUp e noções de AutoCAD e/ou outros softwares 3D;

Experiência com cenografia, ativações de marca e materiais efêmeros;

Boa comunicação e autonomia técnica;

Conhecimento em Trade Marketing e Brand Experience;

Disponibilidade e flexibilidade de horários;

Experiência prévia em agência de marketing, arquitetura promocional ou branding.

Diferenciais:

Repertório visual atualizado e sensibilidade estética;

Capacidade de liderar etapas de projeto e orientar profissionais de diferentes níveis;

Olhar criativo para soluções técnicas inovadoras e sustentáveis;

Vivência em projetos de grande porte e ambientações imersivas.

Formato: PJ e presencial

Local: Florianópolis

title: Analista de Vendas Jr. - Manaus
description:
A DAIKIN é uma empresa multinacional japonesa com sede em Osaka, Japão, e é a maior fabricante de condicionadores de ar do mundo.

No Brasil há 12 anos, a DAIKIN BRASIL possui uma estrutura para atender Distribuidores e Usuários com equipes em São Paulo (SP), Rio de Janeiro (RJ), Recife (PE) e Porto Alegre (RS). Na cidade de Manaus (AM), está localizada a unidade de produção com 350 funcionários, totalizando um quadro de 580 pessoas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Identificar e abordar novos clientes (comerciais, residenciais e instaladoras), comunicando de forma clara as vantagens técnicas dos produtos Daikin.

  • Colaborar na resolução de questões técnicas e comerciais junto a instaladores, engenheiros e especificadores, garantindo um atendimento eficiente e orientado a detalhes.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Iniciar a jornada profissional é um dos capítulos mais emocionantes da vida universitária! E na Stefanini, estamos prontos para transformar esse primeiro passo em uma experiência inesquecível! Apresentamos o Programa Potenciais 2026 , que chegou com toda a energia!

Se você está mergulhado nos estudos e deseja lançar sua carreira com o pé direito, junte-se a nós! Este programa é feito sob medida para você!

Esta é a sua oportunidade de embarcar em uma das maiores empresas de tecnologia do mundo, onde você poderá absorver conhecimento e se destacar como um verdadeiro diferencial no competitivo mercado de trabalho.

Prepare-se para essa aventura e venha conosco!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que vou aprender?

Como estagiário do Programa Potenciais 2026 você irá aprender como funciona o nosso Ciclo Comercial . No período de 1 ano , você terá a oportunidade de vivenciar experiências como:

Comercial

Nessa área você poderá:

  • Apoiar na prospecção e qualificação de leads. Sua principal função não será vender, mas encontrar as oportunidades com alto potencial de fechamento para serem enviadas aos vendedores;
  • Apoiar em licitações e novos contratos de clientes estratégicos, e muito mais;

Pré-vendas

Em que você poderá:

  • Colaborar na elaboração de propostas técnicas, gerar prices e participar de reuniões internas com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar um projeto exclusivo para o Programa Potenciais, que envolve tecnologia aplicada à área de Pré-Vendas.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial para analisar dados, identificar oportunidades e apoiar em projetos internos.

Nesse processo você contará com um time altamente qualificado de gerentes e diretores para capacitá-lo durante sua jornada.

Nosso time de Gente & Cultura estará a postos para desenvolver habilidades e garantir o melhor aproveitamento do programa!

Além de diversos treinamentos e ferramentas que farão com que você se torne protagonista da sua carreira!

Requisitos e qualificações

Quais são os requisitos?

✅ Estar cursando ensino superior;

✅ Ter disponível pelo menos 1 ano e 6 meses para estagiar (se formar a partir de junho/2027);

✅ Ter disponibilidade de estagiar 6 horas por dia em horário comercial;

✅ Ter interesse de atuar nas áreas destacadas no programa (Comercial e pré-vendas), afinal este é o foco do Programa Potenciais;

✅ Ser curioso e ter vontade de aprender todos os dias;

✅ Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente de 3 a 4 vezes por semana em um dos nosso escritórios em Jaguariúna-SP;

⛔ Todos os requisitos são obrigatórios! Preencha seu formulário de inscrição com muita atenção, ok!

❗ Inglês avançado é um diferencial, temos clientes globais!

⚠️ Não nos apegamos a curso ou instituição! O que nós queremos saber é se você topa esse desafio com a gente.

O que oferecemos?

Bolsa Auxílio - compatível com o mercado

Academia Stefanini - Uma plataforma repleta de conteúdo, cursos e treinamentos.

️Assistência psicológica.

E muito mais!

title: Chief Technology Officer - CTO
description:
Purpose of the Position

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) role emerges at a pivotal moment in the company’s evolution. Following nearly three decades of history and a recent ownership transition, the organization is now balancing operational stability with technological transformation, consolidating its position as a leading SaaS platform within Brazil’s financial ecosystem. Acting as the integrator between the strategic vision of the CEOs and the execution capabilities of a technology organization spanning engineering, infrastructure, and QA, the mission is to ensure that technology and business advance in lockstep, sustaining consistent growth while maintaining excellence in uptime, delivery, and scalability.

More than a technical leader, the CTO will operate as an Integrator within the EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) framework, enforcing rhythm, transparency, and accountability across teams. This executive will transform a technically strong but still maturing organization into a disciplined, data-driven, and performance-oriented operation, blending analytical rigor, process management, and a culture of execution in an environment transitioning from founder-led roots toward professional governance. The ideal leader combines technical depth with behavioral maturity, earning the trust of the CEOs and Board through credibility and influence rather than hierarchy. They will guide a complex technology stack, ensuring reliability and compliance in a regulated fintech environment where uptime equals reputation. Equally, this leader will act as a cultural catalyst, fostering engagement, ownership, and process discipline within a Southern Brazilian, engineering-driven culture. Success will be measured by the CTO’s ability to align entrepreneurial ambition with predictable, scalable, and autonomous execution, enabling the company to double in size within the next few years.

Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Modernize without disruption: Lead the migration from a legacy Oracle + .NET Framework platform toward. NET 7 and private cloud, maintaining near-100% uptime for regulated clients.
  • Act as the Integrator of the EOS model: Balance the Visionary leadership of the CEOs by bringing structure, cadence, and operational accountability across teams.
  • Professionalize the technology organization: Transform a historically founder-driven culture into a scalable, process- and data-oriented operation.
  • Build cohesion and leadership depth: Align four technical verticals into one cohesive, high-performing structure.
  • Sustain high performance and growth: Enable technology to support a business plan to double revenues in the next three years while maintaining profitability and quality.
  • Influence and earn autonomy: Gain trust from leadership through credibility, technical acumen, and transparent communication.
  • Drive engagement and culture: Foster collaboration, motivation, and a sense of ownership within the technology organization.
  • Orchestrate transformation across stakeholders: Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical capabilities.
  • Prepare for scale and possible M&A: Build the foundations (architecture, governance, and people) to enable future integrations and scalability.

Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Technology leadership: Experience leading technology or engineering teams of ~50 people, ideally in SaaS, fintech, payments, or financial software environments.
  • Transformation delivery: Proven record of leading modernization programs (e.g., replatforming, architecture redesign, or scalability initiatives).
  • Systems architecture expertise : Deep knowledge of Microsoft technologies (.NET Framework, .NET 6/7, C#, SQL/Oracle) and infrastructure (on-premises and private cloud).
  • Operational excellence: Background in high-uptime or mission-critical environments (e.g., telecom, data centers, financial systems).
  • Process & governance: Experience implementing OKR/EOS or similar frameworks, ensuring cross-functional rhythm and accountability.
  • Stakeholder management: Skilled at engaging Boards, investors, and C-levels, translating technical execution into business outcomes.
  • Team scaling & culture: Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining top talent in growing organizations.
  • Language: Advanced English, for interaction with an international Board environment.
  • Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; MBA or executive education is a plus.

Behavioral Skills

  • Ownership & Accountability – Takes full responsibility for outcomes and results; drives initiatives to completion without requiring constant direction.
  • Transparent & Courageous Communication – Communicates openly and constructively; brings clarity, confidence, and respect to difficult discussions.
  • Learning Agility & Adaptability – Displays curiosity and humility to learn from others; adapts proven methodologies and continuously seeks better delivery methods.
  • Executive Presence with Simplicity – Translates complex technical concepts into clear business language, operating with accessibility and pragmatism.
  • Collaborative Influence – Builds trust and alignment across peers and teams through cooperation and credibility; leads by example.

title: Supervisor(a) Controle de Operações Agrícolas (COA)
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor de Controle de Operações Agrícolas (COA).

Quais as responsabilidades?

Supervisionar as atividades relacionadas ao abastecimento de matéria prima de todas as unidades do grupo, garantindo a execução eficiente das operações da Torre de Controle CTT e Torre de Manutenção elevando a confiabilidade dos apontamos das classes de manutenção do grupo. Coordenar a equipe de operadores, assegurando que todas as metas de desempenho das áreas sejam alcançadas, realizando o acompanhamento diário das operações e implementando melhorias contínuas nos processos.

Quais os requisitos?

Superior completo em Engenharia Agronômica ou áreas afins;

Experiência em operações CTT e Torre de Manutenção;

Sólida vivência com indicadores de performance das operações e equipamentos;

Desejável conhecimento em sistemas como Simplefarm, Gatec, Solinftec, Logtrac;

Gestão de pessoas.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. title: Zootecnista | Confinamento | Pecuária
description:
Zootecnista - Confinamento de Bovinos de Corte

Título da Vaga: Zootecnista - Gestão de Confinamento de Engorda

Local de Trabalho: Monte Alegre de Minas/MG

Modalidade: Presencial | Tempo Integral

A Empresa:

A Green Farming Fazendas Renováveis é uma empresa brasileira especializada na produção de carne de alta qualidade, originária do cruzamento industrial de raças taurinas e zebuínas. Fundada com o objetivo de produzir carne de alto padrão na região do cerrado brasileiro, a empresa tem sede em Monte Alegre de Minas, MG.

Missão do Cargo:

O Zootecnista será o responsável técnico e operacional pela gestão completa do setor de confinamento, garantindo a máxima eficiência produtiva, o bem-estar animal e a qualidade da carne, por meio de um manejo nutricional, sanitário e de gestão de rebanho de excelência.

Principais Responsabilidades e Atribuições:
  1. Nutrição e Formulação de Dietas:
  • Formular e ajustar dietas de alto desempenho para as diferentes categorias de bovinos em engorda, visando o melhor custo-benefício e maximização do GPD (Ganho de Peso Diário).
  • Supervisionar e garantir o controle de qualidade e a correta mistura (homogeneidade) da ração na fábrica e nos vagões forrageiros.
  • Realizar a Leitura de Cocho (Escore de Cocho) diária, tomando decisões assertivas sobre o ajuste da quantidade e do tipo de dieta fornecida.
  • Gerenciar o estoque e a qualidade dos insumos (volumosos, concentrados, núcleos, aditivos).
  1. Manejo Zootécnico e Sanitário:
  • Planejar e executar o protocolo de chegada, adaptação e embarque dos animais.
  • Monitorar diariamente o estado de saúde e o bem-estar dos animais, identificando precocemente problemas sanitários e orientando o manejo do curral-hospital (em parceria com Médico Veterinário, se houver).
  • Gerenciar a formação e a lotação dos lotes de animais (separação por peso, sexo, escore corporal e/ou raça).
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de bem-estar animal e biosseguridade.
  1. Gestão de Pessoas e Infraestrutura:
  • Coordenar, treinar e supervisionar a equipe de trato e manejo do confinamento.
  • Garantir a manutenção e a funcionalidade das instalações (currais, cochos, bebedouros, fábrica de ração, pátio de compostagem).
  • Controlar o uso e a manutenção dos maquinários e equipamentos utilizados no manejo da alimentação.
  1. ﻿ Análise de Dados e Resultados:
  • Coletar, registrar e analisar dados de desempenho (Peso de Entrada/Saída, GPD, Conversão Alimentar, Rendimento de Carcaça).
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais de acompanhamento produtivo e financeiro para a diretoria.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de gestão e softwares específicos para otimizar os processos do confinamento.
Requisitos e Qualificações:
  • Formação: Graduação completa em Zootecnia (Obrigatório).
  • Experiência: Sólida experiência comprovada em Confinamento de Bovinos de Corte (foco em nutrição, manejo de cocho e gestão de equipes).
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos:
  • Domínio em formulação de dietas para bovinos de corte.
  • Conhecimento em softwares de gestão agropecuária e planilhas eletrônicas avançadas (Excel).
  • Conhecimento sobre qualidade de grãos e volumosos.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais:
  • Liderança e Habilidade para gestão e treinamento de equipes.
  • Proatividade, senso de urgência e capacidade de tomar decisões rápidas em ambiente de alta pressão.
  • Comprometimento com resultados, bem-estar animal e sustentabilidade.
Diferenciais:
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Nutrição de Ruminantes ou Produção de Bovinos de Corte.
  • Experiência com sistemas de recria intensiva.
Oferecemos:
  • Salário competitivo (a ser negociado)
  • Moradia na fazenda
  • Fazenda próxima da cidade de Monte Alegre de Minas/MG
  • Benefícios adicionais

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.

HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Royal Enfield - About Us

The oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, Royal Enfield has created beautifully crafted motorcycles since 1901. From its British roots, a manufacturing plant was established in Madras in 1955, a foothold from which Royal Enfield spearheaded the growth of India’s middleweight motorcycle segment. Royal Enfields are engaging, uncomplicated, accessible and fun to ride; a medium for exploration and self-expression. It’s an approach the brand calls Pure Motorcycling .

Royal Enfield’s premium motorcycle line-up caters to varied aspirations and motivations. From stylish retro and neo-retro roadsters like the Hunter 350, the Interceptor 650 and the Shotgun 650, to quintessentially thoroughbred cruisers like the Meteor 350, and the Super Meteor 650; and from adrenaline pumping machines like the all-new Himalayan 450 adventure tourer, the Scram 411 ADV crossover and the Continental GT 650 cafe racer, to the timeless and iconic classics, like the Bullet and the Classic 350; Royal Enfield has an enviable portfolio of motorcycles.

Riders and a passionate community are fostered with a rich profusion of events at a local, regional and international level. Most notable are Motoverse (previously Rider Mania), an annual gathering of thousands of Royal Enfield enthusiasts in Goa, and series of epic rides ranging from peaceful and picturesque to the treacherous and challenging that test the mettle of the rider and the machine, and at the same time deepen the bond between them.

A division of Eicher Motors Limited, Royal Enfield operates through more than 2000 stores across all major cities and towns in India and through nearly 1080 stores in more than 65 countries around the globe. Royal Enfield has two world-class Technology Centres, in Bruntingthorpe, UK, and in Chennai, India. The company’s worldclass, state-of-the-art production facilities are located at Oragadam and Vallam Vadagal near Chennai, along with its legacy facility at Thiruvottiyur, which was Royal Enfield’s first modern manufacturing facility in India, set-up in 1955. Royal Enfield also has modern CKD Assembly facilities across 5 global locations - Nepal, Brazil, Thailand, Argentina and Colombia.

Eicher Motors Limited (EML) (Bloomberg: EIM IN Reuters: EICH.NS) is the listed parent of Royal Enfield, global leader in the middleweight motorcycles segment (250cc - 750cc). For FY ’24, Eicher Motors Ltd recorded a total income of INR 16,536 crores which is approximately USD 2.01 billion.

title: Senior Manager Data Science
description:
ADP is hiring a Senior Manager of Data Science.

  • Are you an experienced leader in Data Science ready for your next-level adventure?
  • Does the thought of working with one of the most comprehensive employment data sets in the world excite you?
  • Are you inspired by transformation and making an impact on the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you a technologist first and foremost who approaches every problem wearing that hat while going out of your way to champion creativity and build diverse, productive, and engaged teams?

IMPORTANT: Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location, It is necessary to live nearby.

Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?

In this role, you'll have access to the most unique and one of the largest HCM data sets and do exploratory analysis to understand if it meets project requirements. It's more than digits and dials - you're making huge decisions that impact millions of customers.

Every day you'll work with multiple stakeholders to identify, design, develop and implement advanced AI and machine learning projects that influence daily life of working people. You'll work with your team to provide, interpret, and predict necessary metrics for decision-making. You'll code with machine learning tools like Python, R, and Scala to synthesize millions of data sets into patterns that answer ad hoc requests and then use Tableau for data visualization. You will create models that guide professional through daily working decisions related to every aspect of working life.

To thrive in this career, you should know how to identify errors and reactively fix them. You'll need to have some formal education in quantitative analytics and know design patterns and data structures. You have the skills to create new models using the technologies above. You will coach and mentor junior data scientists with different strengths to solve various problems with different methodologies and analyses. But given the scale of our data sets and the complex problems we give you to solve, you will stay challenged and engaged with years of exciting projects ahead—all while growing your skills and progressing in a rewarding career.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • Setup, Build and Grow the Team. You will work in close collaboration with the USA Data Science and Machine Learning team to setup the goals and roadmap to assemble a world-class team in close alignment with the company’s OKRs.
  • Own and Manage Projects. You will identify, design, develop, and implement advanced analytical projects.
  • You will design, implement and deploy high-performing machine learning/AI models and create API endpoints in AWS.
  • Advanced Analytics & Predictive Modeling. You bring prior experience to the role of formulating problems, extracting & analyzing data from multiple systems, summarizing critical findings/insights, and developing a compelling visual representation of analyses with actionable recommendations—this will set you up for success on Day 1. You will interact with developer, UX designer, product manager, and senior executives to understand problem domain, project requirements, users experience and demonstrate model performance and its business value
  • Limitless Possibilities. You will continue learning and discovering new ways to leverage ADP data to create new products and services and find more insights. You are passionate about learning and applying new techniques within data science that leads to innovations.
  • Collaboration and Communication. You'll be part of a collaborative team, listening to needs, then finding and sharing solutions. You're comfortable and skilled at presenting to both peers and leadership on your projects and findings.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • PhD in quantitative area and 8+ years’ experience in Data Science or related field is required, with at least 4 years’ experience as a Team Leader.
  • Prior experience in Python, SQL, LMM, IA and distributed computing tools such as Databricks, AWS or other Cloud platforms; Well versed with Scikit-learn, PyTorch or other machine learning libraries and platforms.

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana.

*Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.

description:

title: NetSuite Developer
description:
**To apply, kindly submit your resume in English. Please note that any other format will not be considered.**

Who we are:

Kajae is a premium staff augmentation company that connects top global talents to thriving US companies and clients offering fully remote opportunities. Our team hails from over 27 different countries, with the majority coming from the Philippines and Latin America. We pride ourselves on our tight-knit culture and strong bonds, despite working remotely across diverse timezones.

Benefits :

Competitive salary – paid in USD - Receive your compensation in US dollars, providing stability and global value for your hard work.

100% fully remote setup - Work from anywhere in the world—permanently. Enjoy the freedom and flexibility of a remote role while staying close to what matters most. No more commuting hassles, and more time for life’s important moments.

Healthy work-life balance - We prioritize your well-being. Through regular check-ins during your first few months, we offer ongoing support and career guidance. We also ensure you’re partnered with top-tier clients in a positive, healthy work environment.

Health insurance - Get covered starting your third month with us—your health and peace of mind matter.

Mental health support - Our in-house mental health professional is available to ensure you have access to the emotional and psychological support you need to thrive.

Referral bonuses - Know someone great? Refer them and earn up to USD 100 for every successful hire.

Fun virtual events - We host monthly virtual events filled with games, holiday celebrations, and exciting prizes. It’s a great way to connect and recharge as a team.

Kajae Spotlight bonus - Exceptional performance is recognized through our Kajae Spotlight program, where top performers earn cash rewards.

Kajae Tribe and rewards platform - Engage with the whole team through our internal social platform and earn coins for participating. Use them to bid in our lively auctions for prizes like AirPods, Apple Watches, Starbucks gift cards, shopping or experience vouchers, and more.

Continuing education opportunities - Access 100% free online courses through our university partners in the US. Earn academic credits that can go toward a Master’s or Graduate Degree—completely on us.

All-expense paid summits - Top performers and tenured team members may qualify to attend our exclusive annual summits. So far, we’ve held summits in Palawan, Bohol, and Boracay (Philippines), Cusco (Peru), and Punta Cana (Dominican Republic).

About the Role

We are seeking a talented NetSuite Software Developer who is passionate about building scalable, high-performing applications that integrate seamlessly across business systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue, React, or Angular) , NodeJS backend development , and experience scripting within NetSuite . This position requires both creativity and technical depth to develop integrations, APIs, and dynamic web interfaces while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development: Build modern, responsive front-end interfaces using Vue.js (or similar frameworks such as React or Angular).
  • Back-End Development: Develop and maintain robust NodeJS services that handle data integration and automation.
  • API Integration: Design, implement, and maintain RESTful API endpoints that connect enterprise systems.
  • System Integration: Create and manage integrations between NetSuite and third-party platforms such as Business Central , QuickBooks Online , and Salesforce .
  • NetSuite Scripting: Develop and maintain SuiteScript solutions to enhance NetSuite functionality and improve workflow efficiency.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with project managers, designers, and other developers to solve complex technical challenges and ensure successful delivery.
  • Innovation: Continuously explore new technologies and methods to improve performance, scalability, and maintainability across systems.

Requirements:

  • Develop and maintain backend systems using Node.js and modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue, Angular, or React).
  • Design and implement APIs, integrations, and backend logic for enterprise solutions.
  • Work with third-party APIs and enterprise systems to ensure seamless data flow.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Candidates must have a strong foundation in NetSuite , either as a Functional Consultant or Technical Consultant .

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with accounting concepts or financial software.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms (NetSuite, Salesforce, etc.).
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS).
  • Background in ERP systems or business process automation.
  • Experience with CRM integrations and data synchronization workflows.

title: Webflow Designer
description:
SOBRE A LETS

A LETS é uma empresa de tecnologia que atua na integração de canais de venda com operadores logísticos, potencializando resultados de negócios por meio de soluções inovadoras. Nosso sistema SaaS, chamado Max, é a espinha dorsal que conecta varejistas, operadores logísticos e canais de venda de forma eficiente e automatizada, oferecendo uma experiência simplificada e eficaz para todos os envolvidos. Nossa missão é desenvolver soluções tecnológicas inovadoras que maximizem o desempenho e a eficiência dos negócios, capacitando empresas a alcançar resultados excepcionais.

Estamos crescendo rapidamente e buscamos talentos que queiram fazer parte de nossa jornada, ajudando a transformar o ecossistema de tecnologia e logística para negócios. Se você é uma pessoa com olhar apurado para produto digital, experiência do usuário e front-end em plataformas low-code/no-code como o Webflow , a LET'S é o seu lugar!

SOBRE A VAGA

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Webflow & Experiência Digital para liderar a evolução do nosso site, blog, landing pages e hubs de conteúdo — conectando marca, performance e produto em uma experiência consistente.

É um papel híbrido entre UX/UI Designer e Front-end Low-Code : alguém que entende jornada, navegação, hierarquia de informação, microcopy e conversão, mas também entra no Webflow para estruturar coleções dinâmicas, componentes, interações, integrações e ajustes finos de layout, responsividade e performance.

Você será “dono(a)” do nosso ecossistema Webflow (e ferramentas associadas), garantindo que tudo esteja organizado, escalável e fácil de manter, sempre conectado com times de Marketing, Growth, Produto e Vendas.

ATIVIDADES:

  • Arquitetura e UX do site : estruturar menus, páginas, fluxos, componentes e coleções (CMS) alinhados à estratégia da LETS e dos produtos (Max SalesCloud, Bippi, FiboNash, etc.).
  • Implementação no Webflow : construir e manter páginas, layouts, coleções dinâmicas, formulários, interações, animações e variações responsivas (mobile-first).
  • Design System & consistência visual : organizar estilos globais (tipografia, cores, grids, componentes), garantindo coerência entre site, blog, LPs e materiais digitais.
  • Performance & SEO On-page : otimizar estrutura, headings, imagens, meta tags, URLs, links internos e boas práticas Core Web Vitals.
  • Integrações & low-code : configurar integrações com ferramentas como HubSpot, AirOps, n8n, WhatsApp/API, analytics, pixels e outros conectores sem depender sempre de dev.
  • Experimentação & conversão : propor e testar variações de páginas, CTAs, formulários e mensagens para melhorar conversão, engajamento e qualificação de leads.
  • Criação de estruturas de landing pages: desenvolver e criar modelos de landing pages escaláveis para eventos, material RICO, e outras formas de conteúdo.
  • Documentação & escalabilidade : registrar padrões, boas práticas e guidelines para que o ecossistema Webflow seja sustentável, organizado e fácil de evoluir.
  • Curiosidade técnica : explorar novas features, clonables, bibliotecas e soluções low-code/no-code que ajudem a levar o site “um passo além” sempre.

REQUISITOS:

Eliminatórios (OBRIGATÓRIO):

  • Experiência comprovada (3+ anos) construindo sites, LPs e projetos profissionais em Webflow .
  • Domínio de UX/UI básico a intermediário : wireframes, hierarquia de informação, boas práticas de navegação e usabilidade.
  • Conhecimento sólido de HTML e CSS (para ajustar o que o Webflow gera e criar soluções mais refinadas).
  • Noções de JavaScript suficientes para pequenas interações, embeds e integrações simples.
  • Experiência com design responsivo e otimização para mobile.
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de documentação técnica, tutoriais e comunidades (inclusive em inglês).
  • Perfil hands-on, curioso, autônomo , com vontade de testar, fuçar, perguntar (inclusive para IAs) e aprender rápido.

HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS:

  • Experiência com Figma ou ferramenta similar para prototipação.
  • Familiaridade com integrações Webflow ↔ HubSpot , formulários, CRM, automações (n8n/Make/Zapier).
  • Conhecimento em SEO técnico , Analytics, Tag Manager e pixels.
  • Vivência com marcas B2B SaaS, logística, e-commerce ou last-mile.
  • Noções de motion design (Lottie, microinterações, GSAP ou similar).
  • Noções de A/B testing , CRO e métricas de funil.
  • Espanhol ou inglês intermediário.

BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados .
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Plano odontológico .
  • Seguro de vida .
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível .
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).

DETALHES:

  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .
  • Jornada: tempo integral, com eventuais rituais/treinamentos.
  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .
  • Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD).
  • Em nossos processos seletivos, não há qualquer tipo de distinção em virtude de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, crença, condição social, etnia ou raça .

Como se destacar:

Envie portfólio com projetos em Webflow (links públicos ou clonables), mostrando:

  • antes/depois, raciocínio de UX e decisões de layout;
  • exemplos de coleções dinâmicas, componentes reutilizáveis e interações;
  • casos em que você integrou Webflow com outras ferramentas (CRM, automações, forms, etc.);
  • breve explicação do seu processo (como você estuda, testa, aprende e resolve problemas sozinho(a)).

title: Engenheiro de Pipeline Pleno

  • Automotivado;
  • Dinâmico;
  • Proativo;
  • Nível avançado de proficiência em inglês

Por que a Ausenco?

Apoiamos o crescimento individual e buscamos permitir que você trabalhe de uma forma que valorize seus pontos fortes e atenda às suas necessidades. Conheça nossa proposta de valor:

  • Remuneração e equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal – Além de um pacote de remuneração competitivo, experimente o melhor dos dois mundos com nosso modelo de trabalho híbrido, que permite equilibrar dias no escritório com trabalho em casa. Aproveite os benefícios de políticas de licença modernas, incluindo licença parental remunerada, e celebre conosco feriados especiais.
  • Avanço na carreira - Receba apoio no seu desenvolvimento contínuo através de treinamentos técnicos, programas de mentoria e frequentes oportunidades de networking.
  • Equilíbrio e Bem-Estar – Adote uma abordagem proativa para o seu bem-estar geral. Tenha acesso a aconselhamento confidencial, serviços de saúde e um programa de benefícios que atenda às suas necessidades.
  • Reconhecimento e Valorização - Participe de espaços multidirecionais onde se fomenta uma cultura de reconhecimento local e global, onde todos são reconhecidos por sua contribuição para os negócios e projetos.
  • Comunicação e Compromisso – Vivencie a experiência de trabalhar em uma empresa dinâmica com processos globais e colabore com líderes de renome no setor que valorizam sua contribuição.

Nossos colaboradores não se contentam com o status quo. Se você tem espírito empreendedor e quer ajudar a estabelecer um novo padrão em sustentabilidade, nós o ajudaremos a encontrar seu lugar. Isso significa trabalhar com você para desenvolver uma trajetória profissional e um conjunto de habilidades únicos, que estejam à altura de sua ambição.

Temos orgulho do trabalho que fazemos e o realizamos dentro de uma cultura aberta, honesta e colaborativa. Temos um histórico de atrair pessoas visionárias que abraçam desafios e entregam soluções criativas para cada projeto, e a sua opinião é uma parte importante dessa conversa.

Como empresa global, valorizamos e incentivamos a diversidade em seu sentido mais amplo – identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, experiência, nacionalidade, cor, idioma, religião, localização, deficiência, formação acadêmica, habilidades, estilos de trabalho e disponibilidade de tempo. Nossos ambientes de trabalho são baseados na confiança mútua e no respeito aos direitos e oportunidades de cada indivíduo.

Junte-se a nós e trabalhe de uma maneira melhor.

• Resolver incidentes e problemas recorrentes, garantindo a continuidade dos sistemas críticos;

• Suportar usuários em software e hardware, mantendo comunicação eficaz com diferentes áreas;

• Administrar contratos, fornecedores e custos operacionais;

• Garantir conformidade com padrões de segurança, políticas locais e globais, e requisitos de auditoria;

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.

Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.

The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.

The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.

Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.

Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.

Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.

No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.

About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

  • Monitorar e revisar rotinas contábeis em conjunto com as áreas pares, avaliando as documentações recebidas e garantir a correta contabilização;
  • Preparar e revisar conciliações contábeis de contas patrimoniais e de resultado, garantindo a integridade e exatidão das informações contábeis;
  • Reconciliar contas contábeis, identificando e corrigindo irregularidades;
  • Realizar a apuração de resultados para o fechamento de balanços, assegurando a precisão e conformidade;
  • Analisar e conciliar contas contábeis de ativo/passivo relacionadas a movimentações financeiras e fiscais, distribuindo despesas entre centros de lucro e responsabilidade;
  • Garantir a integridade das interfaces dos sistemas legados e realizar plano de ação quando necessário;
  • Garantir as provisões de resultado em conformidade com o regime de competência;
  • Alimentar o sistema de conciliação da Matriz, utilizado para reconciliação de contas patrimoniais em todas as empresas do Grupo Travelex Brasil;
  • Auxiliar a equipe de contabilidade em dúvidas relacionadas aos processos contábeis;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre a legislação e regulamentações contábeis, aplicando esse conhecimento nas atividades diárias;
  • Elaborar e carregar no sistema da Travelex as bases dos contratos de aluguéis, assegurando conformidade com o IFRS 16;
  • Cumprir as normas e procedimentos regidos pelo Grupo.

Requisitos

Superior completo em Contabilidade, Finanças, Administração ou área relacionada.

Registro ativo no CRC (Conselho Regional de Contabilidade).

Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças ou Controladoria (desejável).

  • Ter um entendimento aprofundado dos princípios contábeis, normas e legislação locais;
  • Ter experiencia com conversão de GAAP (IFRS)
  • Conhecimento em atividades contábeis, como reconciliação de contas, análise de balanços, elaboração de demonstrações financeiras e fechamento de balanços;
  • Experiência com roteirização;
  • Experiência na elaboração de Cadocs;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Softwares de contabilidade.
  • Habilidades analíticas aguçadas para interpretar dados financeiros, identificar padrões, tendências e anomalias nas transações contábeis;
  • Habilidades de comunicação clara e eficaz, tanto para explicar conceitos contábeis complexos quanto para colaborar com outras equipes e partes interessadas;
  • Atenção aos detalhes, garantindo precisão nas transações contábeis e relatórios financeiros;
  • Habilidade para identificar problemas contábeis e propor soluções rápidas e eficientes;
  • Ser capaz de identificar problemas contábeis e desenvolver soluções eficazes, garantindo a conformidade com as normas contábeis.
  • Experiência sólida em controladoria e contabilidade.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

A Travelex é hoje uma especialista em câmbio reconhecida mundialmente, marcando presença em mais de 20 países. No Brasil, o Grupo é formado pelo Travelex Bank, primeiro banco exclusivo para operações de câmbio regulamentado pelo Banco Central no País, e pela corretora Travelex Confidence, com mais de 20 anos de experiência no setor. Dentre as operações realizadas pelo Grupo, estão as operações cross-borders como transferências e pagamentos internacionais, importação, exportação, Mass Payments, banknotes, compra e venda de mais de 20 tipos de moedas estrangeiras, troca de cheques internacionais, venda de cartões pré-pagos, seguro viagem, chip internacional para celular, entre outros. Clientes do Grupo Travelex Confidence contam ainda com atendimento omnichannel incluindo loja online, aplicativo exclusivo, internet banking, mesas de operações com atendimento por telefone ou WhatsApp e mais de 110 pontos de atendimento espalhados por todo território nacional.

Nosso propósito é proporcionar experiência de valor para nossos clientes com Transações de valor, Parcerias de valor e Relações de valor.

Esse é o nosso DNA! Nós somos...

· Versáteis, atendemos todas as necessidades do nosso cliente.

· Apaixonados, entregamos o nosso melhor todos os dias.

· Líderes, somos especialistas e o câmbio está na nossa essência.

· Ousados, criamos sempre novas oportunidades de negócio.

· Responsáveis, somos confiáveis e éticos.

Nossa paixão pelo câmbio continua sendo o que nos move, e criar experiências valiosas e valorosas todos os dias só faz crescer a vontade de sermos ainda melhores.

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. title: Especialista de Inovação para Inteligência Artificial (PO de IA)
description:
A Unimed-BH

Cuidar de vidas é o nosso propósito.

Somos movidos pelos nossos valores e buscamos sempre construir parcerias de maneira ética. Nosso sucesso depende de satisfação dos nossos clientes. Buscamos oferecer a melhor experiência por meio da inovação contínua dos nossos produtos e serviços. Temos o compromisso com a sociedade e atuamos de maneira comprometida com a sustentabilidade.

Somos comprometidos em encontrar soluções ágeis e simples em nosso dia a dia para realizar as melhores entregas para a cooperativa.

Esse é o nosso jeito de trabalhar. Esperamos você para fazer parte do nosso time.

É necessário que tenha:

  • Formação superior completa;
  • Experiência sólida em gestão de produtos/projetos digitais e atuação como PO ou função equivalente, preferencialmente envolvendo inovação tecnológica;
  • Conhecimento de IA e ciência de dados suficiente para dialogar com times técnicos sobre modelos, métricas e viabilidade e Conhecimento aplicado de MLOps no que tange a ciclo de vida completo de modelos (desenvolvimento, implantação, monitoramento e evolução).
  • Familiaridade em arquiteturas de IA Generativa e vivência prática com LLMs (Large Language Models) e agentes autônomos;
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos técnicos em valor de negócio;
  • Modelagem de monetização em IA: estratégias de pricing (subscription, pay-per-use, revenue share) e growth engines (acquisition + retention / land and expand).

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Atuar como PO do portfólio de IA, acompanhando todos os modelos em desenvolvimento, mesmo aqueles que não estejam sob sua execução direta.
  • Gerir prazos, resultados e entregas, cobrando accountability das áreas envolvidas e garantindo alinhamento estratégico.
  • Conduzir execuções via inovação aberta, coordenando parceiros especialistas (outsourcing) para acelerar POCs, pilotos e escalabilidade de modelos.
  • Interagir de forma qualificada com cientistas de dados, engenheiros e profissionais técnicos, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em prioridades de desenvolvimento.
  • Elaborar e defender apresentações executivas para diretoria, conselho e demais stakeholders.
  • Engajar e mobilizar líderes das áreas de negócio, assegurando que estes se tornem patrocinadores e usuários ativos das soluções de IA.
  • Exercer autoridade técnica e institucional, sendo reconhecido como referência em IA, com postura agregadora e inspiradora.
  • Construir pontes internas: envolver áreas críticas e potenciais dificultadores da inovação, desenvolvendo estratégias de colaboração que aumentem fluidez e escalabilidade das iniciativas.
  • Atuar como porta-voz de inovações: representar e defender os projetos de IA em fóruns executivos, com clareza e posicionamento para quebrar paradigmas e destravar decisões.
  • Fortalecer conexões no ecossistema interno: aproximar-se dos demais POs de TI de áreas de negócio, ampliando a integração;
  • Monitorar e aplicar tendências, boas práticas e estimulando benchmarks de IA contribuindo para a evolução e atualização constante das iniciativas da empresa;

title: Senior Benefits Manager LATAM
description:

You’ll serve as a trusted regional expert—partnering closely with Global Rewards, regional and local HR, Finance, Legal, Operations—to create an exceptional employee experience that reflects our culture of innovation, agility, and wellbeing.

  • Partner with internal communications, HR, and local teams to integrate benefits into broader employee experience and wellbeing initiatives.
  • Champion wellbeing, inclusivity, and flexibility in benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our workforce.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage data and market insights to drive benefits strategy and cost management decisions.
  • Track and report key metrics related to participation, utilization, and employee satisfaction.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and digital transformation to enhance efficiency and employee experience.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.

Preferred Skills & Attributes

  • Passion for innovation, technology, and continuous improvement.

  • Skilled at balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution.
  • Culturally fluent and adept at influencing across diverse teams.
  • Commitment to creating inclusive, employee-centered benefits programs.

title: Project and Facilities Manager
description:
A day in the life:

The project and facilities manager of AFF (American Fruits and Flavors) Brazil is responsible for ensuring the warehouse conversion project is completed to AFF standards and to what our contractor agreement outlines. You will ensure the manufacturing facility expansions, equipment installations, and renovations, are maintained within strict timelines and budgets while ensuring compliance with all safety, environmental, and building codes.

Key project management responsibilities include managing project scope, budget, schedule, reviewing construction material specifications and risk; coordinating with internal teams and external contractors; overseeing construction and maintenance activities; and ensuring all operations are safe and efficient for manufacturing processes. This role will be required to provide status reports and any deviations or questions back to key stakeholders from the AFF corporate location.

Key facilities management responsibilities include overseeing the building's daily operations, ensuring its physical infrastructure, safety, and services (like maintenance, cleaning, security, door access, CCTV, Networking infrastructure (IT) and space utilization) meet health/safety standards. This will include managing staff and third-party vendors, coordinating renovations and repairs, handling budgets and contracts, ensuring compliance with regulations, and optimizing space for efficiency. We’re looking for someone who can maintain a positive work atmosphere by behaving and communicating in ways that foster good relationships with employees, co-workers and managers, while achieving performance standards. This person will partner closely with US based project manager to ensure alignment between AFF facilities.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES:

Project Planning & Management:

Ensure comprehensive project plans, scope, budget, and schedules for manufacturing-related facility projects are being met.

Define project requirements and manage the allocation of resources and labor.

Monitor project execution, track progress, and implement corrective actions to stay on schedule and within budget.

Sign off on all installation to ensure it meets defined specifications.

Contractor Management:

Manage project finances, including budget development, forecasting, and cost control.

Approve invoices, manage change orders, and monitor overall project spending.

Select, coordinate, and manage external contractors and vendors to ensure quality and cost-effectiveness.

Safety, Compliance, & Operations:

Ensure all facilities adhere to federal, state, and local codes, as well as industry regulations.

Stakeholder Coordination:

Serve as a liaison between internal departments, senior management, and external stakeholders.

Communicate project status, risks, and issues to relevant parties, fostering effective working relationships.

Maintenance & Operations: Ensure the building's heating, cooling, plumbing, and other critical systems are functioning correctly and safely.

Safety & Security: Implement and oversee security procedures, conduct safety inspections, and ensure the facility complies with all health, safety, and environmental regulations.

Space Management: Maximize the efficient use of the company's space and equipment, coordinating renovations and refurbishments as needed.

Vendor & Contractor Management: Hire, supervise, and manage third-party vendors for services such as cleaning, landscaping, repairs, and maintenance.

Strategic Planning: Contribute to long-term strategic planning for facility maintenance, growth, and improvements.

REQUIREMENTS:

Fluent in English and Portuguese (both written and verbal)

Project Management Expertise: Experience managing three (minimum) similar new build and processing installation projects. Proficiency in project planning tools, scheduling software, and risk management techniques.

Technical Knowledge: Understanding of building systems (mechanical, electrical, structural) and food manufacturing processes.

Financial Acumen: Experience in budgeting, cost management, and invoice processing.

Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with environmental regulations, food manufacturing licensing and permitting and construction codes.

Leadership & Communication: Ability to manage cross-functional teams, resolve conflicts, and communicate effectively with diverse groups.

Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills to assess situations, identify issues, and implement solutions.

Requirements:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 3 years relevant experience working in DevOps roles
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK

  • Business-level proficiency in English

The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach

What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together? A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.

Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality : At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving : We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

We believe that working together across diverse teams not only drives innovation but also builds a supportive environment where everyone's contributions are valued. Our commitment to continuous learning and development is central to our ethos; we invest in career development and mentorship opportunities to help our employees thrive and expand their skill sets. title: Back End Developer
description:
At SOTEC Consulting-Astek Group are seeking a highly skilled Senior Backend Developer to design, build, and maintain robust backend services and real-time data pipelines using Apache Kafka , Spring Boot microservices , and Apache Flink . The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and stream processing, with a passion for building scalable and high-performance backend solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Spring Boot microservices , with a strong emphasis on event-driven architectures powered by Apache Kafka .
  • Implement and optimize Kafka producers, consumers, and stream processing applications, leveraging Apache Flink for real-time data streaming and analytics.
  • Collaborate closely with architects, DevOps, and fellow developers to ensure seamless integration of Kafka, Flink, and microservices across the backend ecosystem.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize Kafka clusters and Flink jobs to guarantee performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Ensure data security, compliance, and adherence to best practices in all Kafka and Flink-related implementations.
  • Participate in code reviews, design sessions, and agile ceremonies , contributing to continuous improvement and technical excellence.
  • Document architectures, technical solutions, and maintain comprehensive and up-to-date system documentation.

Must Have Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering , or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 8+ years of experience in backend development, with a strong focus on Apache Kafka and Spring Boot microservices .
  • Proven hands-on experience with Apache Flink for real-time data processing and streaming .
  • Proficiency in Java or Scala for backend and stream-processing applications.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems , event-driven architectures , and microservices design patterns .
  • Experience with RESTful APIs , message brokers , and data serialization formats (e.g., Avro, JSON).
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to technical challenges.
  • Good communication skills in Portguese (B2 minimum) and English (B1)

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with cloud platforms (preferably AWS ).
  • Knowledge of additional streaming frameworks or technologies .
  • Prior experience in financial services or regulated environments .
  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools , such as the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana).

This is a hybrid position and the candidate selected will need to be present in the office some days.

title: Finance Project Analyst
description:
Netcracker Shaping the Digital Future

As a proud subsidiary of NEC Corporation, Netcracker is a global software leader driving innovation at scale. Powered by cutting-edge technology—and the passion of our people—we unlock new opportunities, spark innovation, and create better digital experiences for millions worldwide. About the role

The Finance Project Analyst will oversee financial performance for assigned projects, focusing on key metrics like budget consumption, invoicing, and cash flow. The role also involves managing vendor contracts, ensuring operational compliance, and escalating financial concerns. Additionally, the analyst will optimize processes, track project health, and assist with forecast, invoicing and payments.

  • Act as a key contact for interpreting and investigating financial results for assigned projects
  • Prepare, reconcile, analyze, and report project KPIs
  • Review actual and planned resources, flag discrepancies to Project Managers
  • Handle project closeout reconciliations and escalate issues as needed
  • Analyze financial and business data for assigned projects and contracts
  • Coordinate with Project Managers on change orders, project status, resourcing, and budgets
  • Assist in developing regular financial status reports for projects
  • Record monthly revenue for contracts and communicate estimates to clients
  • Monitor subcontractor and vendor contracts, acting as the contact point for external/internal resources
  • Attend project meetings to support Project Managers and ensure accurate forecasting
  • Track overall project health, including revenues, gross profit, receivables, and project closeouts
  • Ensure that operational procedures are being followed by Project Teams
  • Identify and work with team leads to resolve and/or escalate violations as needed
  • Validate reports obtained from projects and ensure that the reports are provided on time
  • Work with project team leads and program directors on operational support needs, set up and lead project meetings
  • Assist with Resource plan baselines
  • Review and manage exceptions and escalate to stakeholders as needed
  • Process and distribute reports, defining tool requirements
  • Analyze and monitor dashboard reports on every project created monthly
  • Identify planned projects monthly
  • Identify projects with Level of Effort (LOE) overage and escalate these to senior management
  • Schedule invoices and assist in their payment
  • Work with management to optimize processes

Required Experience

  • 4 or more years experience working in financial analysis
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and the ability to work independently
  • Able to work well with others
  • Able to use discretion while dealing with confidential matters
  • Able to pay close attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

  • Prior experience in portfolio financial management and forecasting strongly preferred
  • Significant past experience in an administrative position with responsibility for audit and processing tasks
  • Ability to follow business rules and procedures while analyzing and identifying errors in processes and data
  • Really good attention to detail
  • Fluent English speaker

Education

  • BSC in Accounting/Finance, or related field
